peltast.projectileDescription: bronze-point wooden javelin, dark shaft, blue binding
peltast.impactDescription: a tiny metallic star flash with a few short ochre dust strokes, not an explosion

veteran_peltast.projectileDescription: reinforced javelin with broader steel point and bronze bands
veteran_peltast.impactDescription: a sharper small white-gold contact spark with 3 metal flecks

temple_adept.projectileDescription: elongated pale-blue magical bolt with a warm gold core and short tapering ribbon
temple_adept.impactDescription: small pale-blue and gold geometric starburst with a thin collapsing ring

temple_seer.projectileDescription: brighter white-blue bolt with two thin gold ribbons around its core
temple_seer.impactDescription: layered white-gold geometric starburst with two very fine blue rings and sparse gold flecks

cyclops.projectileDescription: round irregular grey-brown shaped boulder with readable facets, solid physical stone
cyclops.impactDescription: compact grey stone chips bouncing outward with a small low ochre dust puff

stormforged_cyclops.projectileDescription: same grey boulder with restrained bronze-gold engraved seams, no lightning
stormforged_cyclops.impactDescription: compact stone chips and low dust with a very brief warm glow along two stone fragment seams, no lightning

norse_lindworm.projectileDescription: small pointed icy-blue breath comet with a short white mist tail and a few ice shards
norse_lindworm.impactDescription: small burst of pale ice crystals followed by a soft breath puff that dissipates

norse_storm_lindworm.projectileDescription: denser blue-white frost comet with a brighter angular ice core
norse_storm_lindworm.impactDescription: sharper blue-white ice crystal burst with a thin cold ripple and small fading mist

egyptian_jackal_guardian.projectileDescription: bronze-point javelin with a charcoal shaft and blue-gold bindings
egyptian_jackal_guardian.impactDescription: tiny bronze contact spark and sandy dust flecks

egyptian_anubian_warden.projectileDescription: gold-banded javelin with a dark broad spearhead and blue binding
egyptian_anubian_warden.impactDescription: small warm gold point flash and 3 sand-colored contact flecks, no magic symbols

egyptian_desert_colossus.projectileDescription: angular red-granite block, heavy roughly cuboid carved masonry stone
egyptian_desert_colossus.impactDescription: compact angular red-stone fragments and low ochre dust

egyptian_divine_colossus.projectileDescription: worked red-granite block with small gold and lapis inlay bands on two faces
egyptian_divine_colossus.impactDescription: red-stone debris with a few tiny gold and lapis glints and a low dust puff

japanese_kirin.projectileDescription: slim gold-white holy fire comet, soft curled luminous flame ribbon, no orange smoke
japanese_kirin.impactDescription: small gold-white flame bloom with delicate curled wisps

japanese_celestial_kirin.projectileDescription: white-fire comet with pale gold core and two thin flowing white-gold wisps
japanese_celestial_kirin.impactDescription: white-gold petal-shaped flame wisps and a very fine halo dissolving into specks

celtic_banshee.projectileDescription: two translucent pale teal-silver sound crescents facing right, narrow directed wave pulse, no solid missile
celtic_banshee.impactDescription: small pale teal spectral ripple and curling vapor wisps

celtic_battle_banshee.projectileDescription: three silver spectral sound crescents facing right with restrained dark crimson edge wisps
celtic_battle_banshee.impactDescription: small silver spectral shreds with muted crimson edges, no blood and no skull

mesoamerican_eagle_warrior_spirit.projectileDescription: long slim wooden atlatl dart with dark obsidian-like point and teal feather fletching, NOT a bow arrow, no launcher
mesoamerican_eagle_warrior_spirit.impactDescription: tiny point flash, two dark chips and a little dust flick

mesoamerican_solar_eagle_warrior.projectileDescription: long slim atlatl dart with dark point, gold bands and golden feather fletching
mesoamerican_solar_eagle_warrior.impactDescription: small warm contact glint with sparse feather-like golden motes, no explosion

mesoamerican_xiuhcoatl.projectileDescription: compact orange fireball with restrained turquoise rim and curling flame tail
mesoamerican_xiuhcoatl.impactDescription: tight orange flame curl with turquoise sparks and short-lived embers

mesoamerican_divine_xiuhcoatl.projectileDescription: bright blue-gold flame projectile, white-hot tiny center and blue corona, curled tail
mesoamerican_divine_xiuhcoatl.impactDescription: compact blue-gold flame bloom and falling tiny blue-gold embers

hill_slinger.projectileDescription: small rounded grey sling stone, no sling or hand
hill_slinger.impactDescription: tiny grey chip and dust pop

sling_master.projectileDescription: small elongated almond-shaped dull lead sling bullet, no weapon or hand
sling_master.impactDescription: tiny sharp silver contact flash with two metal-colored flecks, no fire

siege_turret.projectileDescription: slim wooden defensive arrow with steel tip and plain pale fletching, pointing right
siege_turret.impactDescription: small sharp arrow contact flash with a few wood and metal flecks

catapult.projectileDescription: heavy round grey siege stone, physical natural rock
catapult.impactDescription: compact masonry chip burst and low grey-brown dust puff suitable for wall impact

notes: 24 profiles: 22 creature forms and 2 siege actors. Siege rows are distinct actors, not an upgrade pair.
Travel facing +X. Rotate along trajectory; impacts stay centred at contact point.
Physical projectiles use frame 0 by default; three extra painted poses are supplied as optional alternates.
Direct paths avoid the current universal arrow arc. All effects cosmetic.
